---
title: "Installation"
---

## Requirements

- Python 3.10 or higher
- pip or uv package manager

## Basic Installation

After pulling this repository, create a local installation with

```bash
pip install .
```

Or using uv (faster):

```bash
uv pip install .
```

## Development Installation

Clone the repository and install in editable mode:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/bsdlab/aBCI-OSS-example.git
cd aBCI-OSS-example
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```
